name: US Tax Return (Form 1040)
description: US individual income tax return (Form 1040, 1040-SR and schedules) and state returns with the same layout. Hides the taxpayer's, spouse's and dependents' names, SSNs and ITINs (also when written in separate boxes or masked), EINs, the home address and the city, state and ZIP line, the bank routing and account numbers for direct deposit, the Identity Protection PIN, the preparer's PTIN, phone numbers and e-mails. Keeps every amount, line number and label, the tax year and the filing status, so the return still makes sense.

patterns.name: SSN / ITIN
patterns.description: Social Security or ITIN number, with dashes, spaces (form boxes) or masked

patterns.name: EIN
patterns.description: Employer Identification Number (business or preparer firm), NN-NNNNNNN

patterns.name: Routing number
patterns.description: Bank routing number for direct deposit, after its label

patterns.name: Bank account
patterns.description: Bank account number for direct deposit, after its label

patterns.name: IP PIN
patterns.description: IRS Identity Protection PIN, after its label

patterns.name: City and ZIP
patterns.description: City, state and ZIP line of an address block: SPRINGFIELD, IL 62704-1234 (US state codes only).

patterns.name: Phone
patterns.description: Client phone numbers: (555) 123-4567, 555-123-4567, 555.123.4567. Toll-free custodian numbers (800, 888, 877, 866, 855, 844, 833) stay visible; quantity + price columns are not mistaken for phones.
